name: veltrix-app-keycloak
description: Veltrix app: manage Keycloak (open-source Identity and Access Management) as code — clients, client scopes, protocol mappers, realm/client/default roles, groups, authentication flows, required actions, realm settings, client policies/profiles, LDAP/Kerberos user federation, identity providers + mappers, and authorization (resource-server) over the Keycloak Admin REST API, plus BYOL infrastructure provisioning for the Keycloak stack
